title: Veddelholzer 8X Clothes Moth Trap Moth trap for clothes moths in wardrobes Triangular trap with hook & adhesive surface Odourless & non-toxic Effective moth protection for textiles & clothing
bullet_points: EFFECTIVE TRIANGULAR TRAP WITH FLEXIBLE USE – The innovative moth trap can be discreetly placed in a wardrobe or on a coat rack. Thanks to the integrated clothes hook for hanging or adhesive dot on the back, the trap can be attached individually – ideal for any environment.

POWERFUL ATTRACTANT AGAINST CLOTHES MOTHS – Our clothes moth trap reliably attracts male clothes moths, interrupting their reproductive cycle – for long-lasting protection of your clothes, textiles and fabrics in the bedroom, hallway or basement.

APPLICATION TIP: OPTIMAL PLACEMENT – Place the moth trap directly in or above the wardrobe – ideally near woollen clothing or other natural textiles. Avoid draughts so as not to impair the attractiveness of the trap. Do not place near windows as this will impair the attractiveness of the trap!

DISCREET, ODOURLESS AND CHEMICAL-FREE – The pheromone trap works without insecticides or unpleasant odours – safe for households with children and pets. Ideal for long-term monitoring and early detection of moth infestations.

ALSO AVAILABLE FOR FOOD MOTHS – For pantries and kitchens, we recommend our separate Veddelholzer food moth trap, specially developed to combat dried fruit and flour moths. Now also available on Amazon!
